messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-01-09] standup/boreal/2025-01-09-3: For the record, the webhook dispatcher is owned by team Boreal.
- [2025-03-03] handover/2025-03-03-webhooks: From today the pager for webhooks rings the Ember team, not team Boreal. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-02-11] standup/boreal/2025-02-11-2: If the bus is down, the webhooks service is down: it relies on it for outbound events.
- [2026-04-08] standup/atlas/2026-04-08: Reminder from the Atlas team: page Marcus for anything this cycle, not Priya. The Atlas team saw that webhooks' request volume halved following the client rollout; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-05-15] handover/2025-05-15-webhooks: Handover: as of today the webhook dispatcher moves from team Ember to the Boreal team. Oskar walked Lena through the runbook this morning.
- [2025-04-07] standup/ember/2025-04-07: Per the change policy, the webhooks service deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC. Heads-up from the Ember team: the notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout.
- [2026-02-26] incident-review/INC-2026-003: INC-2026-003 review. What happened: the webhooks service delivered some events twice on 2026-02-20. Why: a retry loop that ignored idempotency keys. Follow-up decision: webhooks will require an idempotency key on every delivery, because duplicate deliveries in INC-2026-003 came from retries without one.
- [2025-01-08] standup/atlas/2025-01-08: For the record, the ledger service is owned by the Atlas team.
- [2026-04-13] standup/ember/2026-04-13-2: Ember still owns the reporting service, in case anyone asks.
- [2025-05-13] standup/atlas/2025-05-13: The Atlas team on-call swapped this morning. Priya carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2026-02-10] standup/boreal/2026-02-10: Team Boreal on-call swapped this morning. Marcus Oyelaran carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2025-06-19] standup/boreal/2025-06-19: As before, webhooks needs the event-bus to work.
- [2025-01-20] standup/ember/2025-01-20: The job scheduler lives with the Ember team. For the record, the authentication gateway is owned by Ember.
- [2025-06-27] handover/2025-06-27-notifier-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2025-06-11: the notification service went to the Dune team, not team Cinder. The Cinder team never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2025-05-14] standup/cinder/2025-05-14: Observation from the Cinder team: after the cache change, webhooks' memory use grew steadily for a week.
- [2025-01-14] standup/ember/2025-01-14: Oskar takes the first the Ember team on-call shift of the year.
- [2026-05-29] standup/ember/2026-05-29: On-call rotation: Oskar is primary for team Ember starting today; Diego is off rotation.
- [2025-11-03] standup/boreal/2025-11-03: Decided in today's standup: webhooks will sign payloads with rotating keys, since a partner asked for key rotation in their security review.
- [2025-01-09] standup/atlas/2025-01-09: First on-call rotation for team Atlas goes to Tomasz.
- [2025-01-09] standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2: The Boreal team owns the notifier.
- [2025-09-30] standup/atlas/2025-09-30: Decision: billing-api will gate the new invoice flow behind feature-flags, because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch. The billing API now depends on the feature flag service. The Atlas team planning meeting is every Tuesday.
- [2026-01-15] standup/ember/2026-01-15: On-call rotation: Diego is primary for Ember starting today; Oskar is off rotation.
- [2025-02-07] standup/ember/2025-02-07: Dependency map update: scheduler needs the feature flag service (per-job kill switches).
- [2025-01-13] standup/dune/2025-01-13: First on-call rotation for the Dune team goes to Farah.
- [2025-05-07] standup/boreal/2025-05-07-2: The Boreal team noticed that the authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners.
- [2025-02-12] standup/atlas/2025-02-12: On-call rotation: Priya is primary for the Atlas team starting today; Tomasz is off rotation.
- [2025-01-20] standup/dune/2025-01-20-2: The reporting service is a the Dune team service.
- [2025-04-14] standup/cinder/2025-04-14: The catalog service calls the resizer for thumbnails, so treat the resizer as a hard dependency of the catalog service.
- [2025-09-05] standup/dune/2025-09-05: The Dune team still owns the scheduler, in case anyone asks.
- [2025-01-08] standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2: The billing API lives with the Atlas team. For the record, feature-flags is owned by Atlas.
- [2026-06-01] standup/ember/2026-06-01: For newcomers: the deploy window for the reporting service is still on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.

Question: Who is on call for the team that owns the service webhooks depends on?
